arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/run.test.ts'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('\tit("asks before a rewind drops work only the newest snapshot has')
j=s.index('\tit("saves nothing with worktree_snapshots: false"')
s=s[:i]+s[j:]
s=s.replace('import { REWIND_OPTION } from "./worktree.ts";\n','')
s=s.replace('''import {
	captureState,
	DEFAULT_SNAPSHOT_LIMITS,
	recordSnapshot,
	writeStash,
} from "./storage/worktree.ts";''','import { DEFAULT_SNAPSHOT_LIMITS } from "./storage/worktree.ts";')
# restore inline tick
i=s.index('/** Someone with write access ticks `label` on question comment `id`: the `issue_comment` `edited` event. */\nfunction tickEvent(')
j=s.index('/** Git as on a runner')
s=s[:i]+s[j:]
s=s.replace('''		const tick = (id: number, label: string, sender = "ada") =>
			tickEvent(w.gh, id, label, sender);
''','''		/** Someone with write access ticks `label` on question comment `id`: the `issue_comment` `edited` event. */
		const tick = (id: number, label: string, sender = "ada") => {
			const before = w.gh.bodies.get(id) ?? "";
			const after = before.replace(`- [ ] ${label}`, `- [x] ${label}`);
			w.gh.bodies.set(id, after);
			return {
				action: "edited",
				issue: {
					number: 42,
					title: "Fix the thing",
					body: "It is broken",
					user: { login: "o", type: "User" },
				},
				comment: {
					id,
					body: after,
					user: { login: "github-actions[bot]", type: "Bot" },
					author_association: "NONE",
					created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
					updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
					html_url: `https://github.com/o/r/issues/42#issuecomment-${id}`,
				},
				changes: { body: { from: before } },
				sender: { login: sender, type: "User" },
			};
		};
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/storage/worktree.test.ts'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('describe("uniqueWork"')
s=s[:i].rstrip()+"\n"
s=s.replace('\tuniqueWork,\n','')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff origin/main --stat -- src/run.test.ts; sed -n 120,145p src/worktree.test.ts
